Name: Instant Tool Upgrades
Author: binarynova
Description:
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6!
[/list]
[u]Installation[/u]
[list]
[*]Install automatically using Vortex, or extract the contents of the .zip file into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[/list]
[u]About[/u]
[list]
[*]Instead of forcing the player to wait two days for their upgraded tool, this mod gives the player the new tool right away. Only a small amount of code was needed for this change.
[*]In addition, this mod changes two strings in the English version of the game to remove references to the wait time.
[/list]
[u]Source
[/u][list]
[*]The source code for this and my other Stardew Valley mods can be found on GitHub [url=https://github.com/Binarynova/MyStardewMods]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[u]Donations[/u]
[list]
[*]NexusMods directs 100% of Donation Points earned by this mod to the [url=http://www.wcs.org]Wildlife Conservation Society[/url]﻿.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: This mod makes Clint give you your upgraded tools immediately. No more waiting two days for your important tools! Now compatible with 1.6!
